pages.title: Authentication and Sign-In
pages.purpose: The three auth paths (client-hashed password, Cloudflare Access JWT, gatekeeper-based sign-in via PendingLogin DO) and why auth config is env-driven rather than admin-config.
instructions: Cover the SERVICE_SALT argon2id scheme from api.ts and where tokens are stored.
State clearly which env vars gate each mode (DISABLE_PASSWORD_AUTH, CF_ACCESS_AUD/ISS, AUTH_GATEKEEPERS).

pages.title: Platform Architecture Overview
pages.purpose: What the Gadgets Workshop is, package topology (kernel/gatekeepers/frontend/shared), trust boundaries, and the end-to-end request flow from browser to Durable Objects to gatekeepers.
instructions: Explain kernel-vs-gatekeeper ownership boundary and capability-based security framing.
Ground the package list in the actual packages/ directory and workspace manifests.

pages.title: Cap'n Web RPC Protocol and API Surface
pages.purpose: How the WebSocket RPC layer works: interface hierarchy (PublicApi → AuthenticatedApi → Overseer/GadgetClient), promise pipelining, validateRpc runtime validation, stub lifecycle/disposal, and error codes.
instructions: Cite the interface definitions in workshop-shared/src/api.ts with line evidence.
Cover the useState-wraps-stub and stub-disposal conventions and why they exist.

pages.title: AI Agent System
pages.purpose: The agent loop (pi-agent-core), available tools (file edits, executeCode, web fetch), chat change budgets and step buffering, compaction, ambient gatekeeper capsules/bindings, and the agent spawner.
instructions: Cover how executeCode runs in a dynamic worker via LOADER and how bindings/gatekeepers are exposed.
Explain CHAT_CHANGE_MESSAGE_BUDGET and STEP_CHANGE_BUDGET rationale from the doc comments.

pages.title: AI Models, AI Gateway, and Usage Limits
pages.purpose: Model configuration (per-user model records, LanguageModelGatekeeper), AI Gateway routing and cost extraction, Cloudflare connection service, and the usage/quota enforcement chain.
instructions: Distinguish the Cloudflare gatekeeper's three purposes (auth, billing, observability).
Ground the quota check (checkUsageAndBalance) and daily quota config in source.

pages.title: Blueprints: Templates, Archives, and Screenshots
pages.purpose: Blueprint metadata in KV, content in R2, the .gadget archive format, bundled format-blueprints and their generator, screenshot pipeline, and featured/library flows.
instructions: Cite the public (unauthenticated) blueprint endpoints in api.ts.
Explain the reserved KV key (.adminConfig) and blueprintId immutability rule.

pages.title: Gadget Code Storage: Git Objects and Code Changes
pages.purpose: The refless content-addressed git object store inside each overseer, the shared CodeChange format, three-way merge, and the Yjs→git migration.
instructions: Cover applyCodeChange/composeCodeChange semantics from workshop-shared.
Summarize the git-store.ts design rationale (no refs, no GC, 2MB bounds).

pages.title: Backend Kernel: server.ts and API Implementations
pages.purpose: The workshop-backend worker entrypoint: fetch handler, PublicApi/AuthenticatedApi implementations, admin config and AdminSettings DO, entrypoint re-exports, and environment bindings.
instructions: Cover KV/R2/browser/LOADER bindings from wrangler.jsonc.
Explain ctx.exports DO access, wrapDoStubForTelemetry/retryOnDoReset helpers, and the admin capability minting (#isAdmin once at getAdminApi).

pages.title: OverseerDurableObject: Workspaces and Chats
pages.purpose: The per-workspace DO: open() handshake, multi-gadget workspaces, chat lifecycle, outputs sync, loopback entrypoints, alarm-based agent keep-alive, and the restore/forger stub machinery.
instructions: Document OverseerImpl vs the DO wrapper, the alarm() contract, and the code-mode/restore-forger harnesses with line evidence.
Explain who may open a workspace (owner verification, share keys, collaborators).

pages.title: Sharing and Collaboration
pages.purpose: How workspaces are shared: collaborator roles, share keys/links, the SharingManager capability checks, and affected-collaborator notifications.
instructions: Ground role semantics and share key records in sharing.ts.
Note how shared gadgets appear in the user's DO records (owner field).

pages.title: UserDurableObject: Per-User State
pages.purpose: The user Durable Object's owned records: login sessions, connected accounts, gadgets, blueprints and library, outputs index, AI model config, and daily quotas.
instructions: Explain the outputs catch-up paging (OUTPUTS_BACKFILL_PAGE) and auto-provisioned account protection.
Ground record shapes (ConnectedAccountRecord, BlueprintUserRecord, GadgetRecord, WorkspaceOutputEntry) in source.

pages.title: Gadget Sandbox and Client Integration
pages.purpose: How gadgets run in sandboxed iframes, the postMessage RPC bridge to the gadget's server-side DO stub, gadget exports (browser render, Puppeteer PDF), and the capsule overlay.
instructions: Cover export formats and the GadgetExportEntrypoint.
Ground the no-network-except-postMessage sandbox claim in api.ts header comments.

pages.title: Frontend SPA and Connection Lifecycle
pages.purpose: The workshop-frontend single-page app: WebSocket connection management with backoff/probes, React contexts, routing, and state conventions for RPC stubs.
instructions: Cover the stub-in-object useState convention.
Explain the reconnect/probe machinery constants and why connection mgmt lives outside React effects.

pages.title: Shipped Gatekeeper Connectors
pages.purpose: Survey of the shipped gatekeepers: Cloudflare (auth/billing/observability), Context Library, Scheduled Tasks, the two MCP connectors with mcp-shared, and the OAuth service connectors (GitHub, Google, Linear, Notion, Slack, etc.).
instructions: Cover the MCP trust boundary (tools.ts, readOnlyHint, vetted portal) and mcp-shared's role.
Ground each connector's distinguishing behavior in its source; avoid exhaustive per-file narration.

pages.title: Gatekeeper Contract
pages.purpose: The workshop-shared gatekeeper interfaces (GatekeeperVendor, GatekeeperUser, Gatekeeper session DO, ApprovalQueue, hooks, observations vs actions) and their trust semantics.
instructions: Cover HookController/HookInitiator and ObservationAuthorizer contracts with line evidence.
Explain observation-vs-action approval semantics and the vetted/trust model.

pages.title: Gatekeeper Connection Lifecycle and Policy
pages.purpose: How accounts get connected or auto-provisioned: the connect flow with nonce, provisioning-policy modes (disabled/optional/enabled), admin-config gating at getGatekeeperClassFor, ambient singletons, and credential expiry.
instructions: Cover autoProvisionsAccount and createAccount() having no user identity.
Ground the three-state mode resolution and the user.ts chokepoint for disabled vendors.

pages.title: Change Guide: Adding a Gatekeeper
pages.purpose: Step-by-step guide for adding a new gatekeeper package: vendor/user/session DOs, configurator UI, wrangler bindings, router discovery, deploy inputs, and registration in admin config.
instructions: Ground steps in how existing gatekeepers are wired (GATEKEEPER_* binding naming, deploy-inputs.json, configurator build tasks).
Note auto-provisioning and singleton/UI declaration options.

pages.title: Change Guide: Extending the RPC API
pages.purpose: Step-by-step guide for adding or changing an RPC method across workshop-shared, workshop-backend, and workshop-frontend, including doc-comment and validation requirements.
instructions: Include the kernel review bar: doc-comment every exported member, avoid hand-written mirror interfaces and as-unknown-as casts.
Mention capnweb-validate regenerating checks and pipelining/stub-disposal conventions.

pages.title: Build System and Dev Server
pages.purpose: The vp (vite-plus) task system with caching, per-package build tasks, the dev-server composition (watchers, generated configs), format-blueprint codegen, and lint setup.
instructions: Explain build:app/build:app:dev and configurator builds.
Ground the env-stripping and cache rules in the actual vite.config.ts and scripts.

pages.title: Observability, Logging, and Error Reporting
pages.purpose: The server-side logger conventions, observability context, tracing, the issue Reporter path, and the separate frontend error-reporting pipeline with its trust rules.
instructions: Cover the /api/client-errors endpoint gating bindings and the postMessage frame rules.
Ground level semantics and no-secrets rules in backend-utils source.

pages.title: Release Pipeline
pages.purpose: How customer instances get releases: build-release bundling, the manifest contract and placeholders, R2 content-addressed upload with candidates, and promotion as a manifest copy.
instructions: Cover deploy-inputs.json and NO_DEFAULT_CRED_INPUTS.
Ground the candidate/promote flow and serialization requirement in the scripts.

pages.title: Testing Strategy
pages.purpose: How tests run across the workspace: cached vp test tasks, workerd-pool suites with assert-workerd, the integration-tests package harness, and root scripts tests.
instructions: Cover what the integration harness provides (mock model, network interceptor, RPC client).
Explain test:run vs cached test task tradeoffs and the watchdog timeouts.

pages.title: Quickstart
pages.purpose: Practical onboarding: prerequisites, install, running dev server/client, build, test, lint commands, and a guided first tour of the codebase.
instructions: Include the exact commands from package.json scripts (pnpm dev-server, pnpm dev-client, pnpm build, pnpm test, pnpm lint).
Keep it practical; link concept pages for depth.
